ext.description: Automatic, per-window time tracking for each project.
view.container.title: Time Tracking
view.history.name: History
config.title: Time Tracking
config.inactivityThreshold.desc: Minutes of inactivity (window focused but no edits, selection, navigation, terminal or task activity) before the session is paused.
config.bgTimeout.desc: Minutes a non-debug background process (shell command, plugin) may run without interaction before tracking pauses.
config.focusCap.desc: Safety cap, in minutes, of a focused window with no activity (thinking/reading still counts up to this). When reached, the idle tail is treated as a forgotten session and is not counted. `0` means never pause while focused.
config.debugCap.desc: Safety cap, in hours, after which an active debug session stops keeping tracking alive without interaction. `0` disables the cap (a running debug session always keeps tracking active).
config.minSession.desc: Minutes below which a session you pause by hand is treated as noise: it is discarded (not counted) and tracking returns to awaiting confirmation rather than paused. `0` keeps every session.
config.fontSize.desc: Font size, in pixels, for the History panel. The panel's text scales from this base. `0` follows the editor font size.
config.gitUserEmail.desc: Git `user.email` used to count your commits of the day. Leave empty to read it from the repository configuration.
config.debugLogging.desc: Write a detailed activity log (signals, decisions, recorded intervals) to the "Time Tracking" output channel and to a log file in the extension storage. For debugging only.
capabilities.untrusted.desc: Tracking works in untrusted workspaces, but counting git commits is disabled until the workspace is trusted.
capabilities.virtual.desc: Tracking stores data and watches files on the local filesystem, so it is limited in virtual workspaces.
